requirement.text: Users must be informed when they are interacting with an AI system.

stakeholders: AI system providers or development team (strongly implied as responsible for providing the information)
analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure transparency by making users aware when an interaction involves an AI system.
required_behaviors: Inform users that they are interacting with an AI system.
Provide this information in connection with the user’s interaction with the AI system.
constraints: The information must be provided to users.
The disclosure must concern the fact that the user is interacting with an AI system.
The requirement does not specify the disclosure’s wording, format, interface location, timing, frequency, or delivery mechanism.
verification_targets: Whether a user interacting with the AI system receives information identifying that the interaction is with an AI system.
Whether the disclosure is available in the relevant interaction context rather than only outside it.
Whether the disclosure clearly communicates AI-system involvement.
ambiguities: Which interactions and user channels are in scope.
When disclosure must occur (for example, before, at the start of, or during an interaction).
Whether informing users once is sufficient or whether repeated disclosure is required.
What content, detail, language, accessibility provisions, or comprehension standard the information must meet.
Whether the requirement applies where AI involvement is partial, indirect, or combined with human interaction.
Who is accountable for presenting the information.
unsupported_inferences_to_avoid: Do not require a specific label, wording, visual design, notification mechanism, consent flow, or acknowledgment.
Do not infer that users must be told about model identity, capabilities, limitations, data use, decision logic, or human oversight.
Do not introduce timing rules, repetition rules, accessibility standards, or language requirements not stated in the source requirement.
Do not assume a particular application domain, communication channel, or interaction modality.
Do not infer legal compliance obligations, recordkeeping, audit trails, or penalties.

initial_draft.title: Inform Users of AI Interaction
initial_draft.description: As a user interacting with the system, I want to be informed that I am interacting with an AI system, so that I am aware of the AI system’s involvement in the interaction.
work_items: Provide information to users in the context of their interaction that identifies the system as an AI system.
Verify that a user interacting with the AI system can access information clearly communicating that the interaction involves an AI system.

issues.problem: The work items establish that AI-system identification must be provided in the interaction context, but they do not further operationalize what implementation outcome demonstrates that the information is actually provided to the user rather than merely being available somewhere in that context.
issues.recommended_change: Revise the verification work item to check that the disclosure is presented to users during the relevant interaction context, while leaving its wording, format, placement, and timing unspecified because the source requirement does not define them.

issues.problem: “Can access information clearly communicating” is testable at a high level, but “clearly” and the relevant interaction context are not operationally defined in the EUS. These limitations largely reflect ambiguity in the source requirement and should not be resolved by imposing unsupported design criteria.
issues.recommended_change: Specify the test in terms of confirming that, in each implemented interaction flow within scope, the user is presented with or can access information identifying the system as an AI system; do not add particular wording, interface, timing, or comprehension standards.

issues.problem: The verification item tests whether the disclosure is accessible, but does not explicitly verify that it is presented to users in the interaction context such that they are informed, as required.
issues.recommended_change: Revise the verification criterion to confirm that, during an in-scope interaction, the user is presented with clear information identifying the interacting system as an AI system.
